freeze_meaning: Stable bounded evidence, full candidate accounting and adjudicated judgements. Not universal certainty, representative effectiveness of every property, or empirical validation of the exact composition.
scope: Independent, plural and criticism-tested BPM study covering B1–B10 and within-tradition composition. The field is treated as organisational and socio-technical as well as analytical and executable.
scope_boundaries: No requester repositories, sibling Evolved corpora, runtime designs or target-specific adoption claims were consulted.
Workflow and process mining are examined at documented BPM interfaces; complete algorithmic, formal and implementation histories of those fields are outside this lane.
Industrial/quality antecedents are traced through explicit founding-source discussion, not a claimed complete independent history of every antecedent school.
Business analysis, enterprise architecture and project management are distinguished at the problem/unit/decision boundary; their complete professional standards are not reconstructed.
No jurisdiction-specific legal compliance or sector-specific clinical/safety procedure is prescribed.
No effect-size meta-analysis, population prevalence estimate or complete database-indexed literature census is claimed. The denominator is the examined analytical candidate population.
Live products are not benchmarked as current commercial recommendations. Standards versions are distinct from implementation adoption.
Publication/deposit/issue/event dates are distinguished; the future 2026 BPM conference is not completed empirical evidence.
source_independence_note: Source and study-summary counts are not counts of independent causal effectiveness experiments. Shared programmes, cases and benchmark logs remain identified.

composition.validation_boundary: Exact composed system is analytical, not directly field-validated as a whole.

evidence_limits: No universal BPM benefit, BPR failure rate, maturity-to-outcome causal effect or autonomous-revision guarantee is established.
Formal guarantees are bounded by encoded constraints, model semantics and history assumptions; those assumptions are not proven true of real work.
Field and design evidence is context-bound; failed adoption, selection, confounding, self-report and common datasets are retained.
S006 and S048 were inspected at publisher contents/abstract level, not as a fully read textbook; S013 is a specification record, not inspected DMN normative clauses.
S026, S038, S040 and S047 have abstract-only access limits; omitted methods and effects are not invented.
Pre-1990 quality ancestry and early office-system roots include explicitly indirect or retrospective evidence; priority beyond the inspected sources is not asserted.
S034 is a 2026 research manifesto, and S039 describes an event still future at the cut-off; neither is evidence of completed operational replication.
Competing legitimate interests and the external validity of the exact analytical composition remain examined open questions.

substantive_review_record.evidence: Ten developed domain models; twenty dated genealogy nodes and twenty-one classified relationships, with indirect historical sources labelled.
Twenty-two criticism entries change retention or conditions; non-implementation, null results, model/work discrepancies, maturity and current analytical counter-results remain visible.
Current 2026 sources inspected alongside 2021–2025 evidence; agendas, editions, issue/deposit dates and future events distinguished.
73 stable IDs and primary dispositions; 58 conditional candidates,14 nonretained,1 unresolved; zero NOT_EXAMINED records.
Ten artefact categories plus per-property consumers, prerequisites, cheaper alternatives and retirement conditions.
Exact source records, claim locators, seven separate per-property evidence partitions, study design details and dependence register.
Nine costed tensions with discriminators,67 guarded relations,five alternatives,four revision boundaries and fourteen labelled tests.
